description: Default spec of bench soak (testing strategy T3). Two paced sessions of small mixed transactions: inserts, updates, key changes, deletes, savepoint and full rollbacks over three tables, with a 50 ms pause after each transaction so the capture keeps up on a workstation lab. Inserts and deletes are balanced so the tables stay small however long the run. LOB writes are off because the lab's example connector runs with cdc.lob.mode=skip (set lobWeight above 0 only with inline or reselect); truncates, DDL and large transactions are off so every check compares like with like. bench soak runs the spec open-ended and ends it itself, so the duration below only matters to bench workload.
